overall: Rerun with haiku of dirty_data, dirty_data_keep_gaps and restricted_model (15 sessions): 8 correct, 7 improvable, 0 fail. Nothing written before the user agreed (0 of 12), the 11 corrected copies are right line by line, no restricted model run (0 of 3, from 1 of 3 in the first run). The backtest error about a missing target value read before a fold is still placed inside a test fold by 6 of the 11 sessions that got it: #130 reworded only the forecast case; #131 rewords the backtest one. The automatic FAIL of dirty_data__r3 is right (no copy exists) but not a fail verdict: after a denied heredoc the agent gave up the copy and told the user. The WARNs are harness denials while writing the agreed copy.

findings.title: The error and the warning of a backtest about a missing target value read before a fold are still read as a gap inside a test fold: #130 reworded only the forecast message, not this one.
findings.evidence: Every dirty_data and dirty_data_keep_gaps session that ran a backtest (11 of 12) received `The forecaster reads missing values of the target to predict 1 of the 3 test folds ('x': 1 value(s), such as '2004-10-01')`. 2004-10-01 lies in the training data (initial training up to 2005-06-01), and the backtest with RandomForestRegressor that follows scores all 3 folds (36 rows). 6 of 11 final answers put the date inside a test fold: dirty_data__r2 (`falls in a test fold`), dirty_data__noskill__r1, dirty_data__noskill__r2 (`failed on the fold that includes 2004-10-01`, after reading it right in its running text), dirty_data__noskill__r3, dirty_data_keep_gaps__r3 (`One test fold (2004-10-01) is one of the missing months`), dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r3. 3 of them draw a false consequence from it: dirty_data__r2 `that fold's error is less reliable`, dirty_data__noskill__r2 `Imputing them would let the backtest ... run on every fold`, dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r3 `the 2004-10 predictions are not reliable`. 4 read it right (dirty_data__r1, dirty_data_keep_gaps__r1, dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r1, dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r2: `a test fold is predicted from the missing October 2004 value`), 1 is ambiguous (dirty_data_keep_gaps__r2). Reproduced outside a session at 8b58812, which includes #130: `ForecastingAssistant().backtest(...)` on the copy of dirty_data_keep_gaps__r2 raises DataContentError with the same text. In `skforecast_ai/_last_window.py`, `_report` keeps `The forecaster reads missing values of the target to predict{where}` whenever `where` is set (a backtest); #130 (45b3e37) added the new wording `The last window of the target, the values the forecast starts from ...` only for the branch without `where` (a forecast). No session here reaches that branch (2004-10 is not in the last window of the forecast), so the change the addendum describes was not exercised by these scenarios.
findings.action: Fixed in #131: the backtest error and warning now say that the values come before the start of the folds it names. Rerun of dirty_data and dirty_data_keep_gaps with haiku after the merge.

findings.title: Figures and statements of the agent's own in otherwise right answers.
findings.evidence: dirty_data__r1, turn 1: `12 monthly steps (Nov 2026 to Oct 2027)`, a window taken from today's date, not the data (it ends in 2008-06); turn 2 retracts it (`that was wrong`). dirty_data__noskill__r3: `The forecast is less reliable than the usual setup because I had to change the model` and `the strong seasonal pattern in the history`. dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r3: `The series has a clear seasonal pattern`. restricted_model__r2: `It does not require a Hugging Face account`, which neither the message nor the hint of `model_not_allowed` says. dirty_data__r3: `there may be others` against `Found 1 timestamp`. 5 of 15 sessions (3 of these 15 in the first review).
findings.action: Nothing to change in the library: the skill and the instructions already ask to quote only what a response gives. Report the rate in the log of the weaker model.

findings.title: After a denied shell command, one session gives up the corrected copy although `Write` and `python3` were allowed.
findings.evidence: dirty_data__r3 tries `mkdir -p /tmp/h2o_fix && cat > ... <<'EOF' ... python3 -I keep_first.py ...` (neither `mkdir` nor `cat` is among the allowed prefixes). The denial text of the client says `do not retry it: this action, and anything else that requires approval, will be denied`; the agent stops, says honestly that nothing was written, and adds that retyping the rows with `Write` is ruled out by `the server's rules`, which no rule says (the skill only forbids opening the data to look at it). The 4 other sessions with a denied command recover: dirty_data__r2 and dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r2 run the same `python3 -c` without `cd /tmp`, dirty_data_keep_gaps__r3 and dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r1 use `Write`. It also asks again for the horizon in both turns.
findings.action: None in the library. If it repeats, the Data problems section of the skill could say that the corrected copy can be written with the file tool of the client once the user agreed. In the harness, the denial text of Claude Code is not under our control; the check result is right (see check_marks).

findings.title: The agent asks again for a horizon the user already gave.
findings.evidence: The request says `the next 12 months`. dirty_data__r1 (`I'd also need the forecast horizon, which I'm assuming is 12 monthly steps`), dirty_data__r3 (`what horizon do you want, in months?` in turn 1 and `still open: the horizon in months` in turn 2), dirty_data_keep_gaps__r1 (`Tell me if you meant something else`). 3 of 12, all with the skill loaded; never a call with another horizon.
findings.action: None required, as in the first review.

findings.title: Without the skill, `profile` is called without `target` although the user named `x`.
findings.evidence: dirty_data__noskill__r2, dirty_data__noskill__r3 and dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r2 call `profile` without `target`, get `target was not given` with the columns, and pass `x` at the next call. 3 of 6 sessions without the skill, 0 of 6 with it. One extra call each, nothing else.
findings.action: None: the hint corrects it at the first attempt.

findings.title: After `model_not_allowed`, two answers still name the recommended Ridge plan as an option, against `Name no other model`.
findings.evidence: restricted_model__r1 (`That's a fallback if you don't want a foundation model`) and restricted_model__r2 (option 3, `Use the recommended local model`). Neither runs it; Ridge has no license of its own. 2 of 3, as in the first review.
findings.action: None: harmless, and the hint already says it.

dirty_data__r1.notes: Turn 1 names the three problems and asks, writing nothing, but invents a forecast window (Nov 2026 to Oct 2027) and asks again for the horizon; turn 2 retracts the window openly. Writes the copy with an allowed python3 script (first 2006-01-01 value kept; it also drops the identical 2002-09-01 row it had asked about, disclosed and harmless), profiles it, switches to RandomForestRegressor after the rejected backtest, says so and reads the error right (`a fold that uses one`).

dirty_data__r2.notes: Asks in turn 1; in turn 2 its `cd /tmp && python3` is denied, it reruns the script without `cd`, writes the copy exactly as told (the identical row kept), profiles it, switches the estimator after the rejected backtest and says so. The answer says 2004-10-01 `falls in a test fold` and that `that fold's error is less reliable`, which nothing supports (the date is in the training data).

dirty_data__r3.notes: Turn 1 names the problems and asks, but adds `there may be others` against `Found 1 timestamp` and asks for the horizon. In turn 2 a `mkdir && cat <<EOF` script is denied (harness) and it stops: honest that nothing was written, but it declines `Write` by a rule the server does not have, asks again for the horizon, and leaves the user with no copy and no forecast.

dirty_data__noskill__r1.notes: Asks in turn 1, proposing to drop the identical row; in turn 2 writes the copy with `Write` (verified against the original: the second 2006-01-01 row and the identical 2002-09-01 row removed), profiles, switches to RandomForestRegressor after the rejected backtest and says so, metrics and forecast from the responses. Minor slip: the 2004-10 gap `falls in a test fold`.

dirty_data__noskill__r2.notes: Calls `profile` without the named target first, then asks properly and writes the right copy with `Write` (identical row kept, as told). Its running text reads the backtest error right, but the answer says the backtest failed `on the fold that includes 2004-10-01` and that imputing would let the backtest `run on every fold`, while all 3 folds were scored.

dirty_data__noskill__r3.notes: Profile without target first, then the right copy with `Write`, profile, estimator switched and disclosed. The answer adds statements of its own: the forecast `is less reliable than the usual setup because I had to change the model`, `the strong seasonal pattern in the history`, and the 2004-10 gap `falls in a test fold`.

dirty_data_keep_gaps__r1.notes: Asks in turn 1 (and asks to confirm the horizon); turn 2 writes the copy with `Write` exactly as told (mean 1.2922255, identical row dropped, gaps kept; all checks pass), profiles, switches the estimator after the rejected backtest and reads the error right. Ends offering to `rerun the comparison` that never ran.

dirty_data_keep_gaps__r2.notes: Same right flow and copy as r1, with the estimator switch disclosed and no baseline claimed. Small imprecision: `Ridge cannot predict from the 3 missing months` and `one test fold (2004-10-01) reads a missing value`, ambiguous about where the date is.

dirty_data_keep_gaps__r3.notes: Inspects the repeated rows with read-only commands, its awk write into data/ is denied (harness), and it writes the right copy with `Write`, profiles, switches the estimator and says so. Minor slip: `One test fold (2004-10-01) is one of the missing months`; 17 calls.

dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r1.notes: Asks in turn 1; in turn 2 a script is denied (harness) and it writes the right copy with `Write`, profiles, reads the backtest error right (`one test fold is predicted from the missing 2004-10-01 value`), switches the estimator and says so. A failed `cat -A` and the denied script cost two calls.

dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r2.notes: Profile without target first; after the agreement its `cd /tmp && python3` is denied and the same script without `cd` writes the right copy (117 rows), which it profiles. Reads the error right (`one fold is predicted from the missing 2004-10-01 value`), switches and discloses the estimator, quotes the metrics as given.

dirty_data_keep_gaps__noskill__r3.notes: Right copy with `Write`, profile, estimator switched and disclosed. The answer says the missing 2004-10 value `falls inside a test fold`, that `the 2004-10 predictions are not reliable` (there are none), that confirming the gaps would let Ridge run, and that the series has `a clear seasonal pattern`.

restricted_model__r1.notes: Profile, then `model_not_allowed`; stops at once, gives the license and its URL from the message, the restart with `--allow-model google/timesfm-3.0` and Chronos-2 with its registered license, and runs nothing. Mentions the recommended Ridge plan as a fallback, against `Name no other model`, without running it.

restricted_model__r2.notes: Stops after `model_not_allowed` and gives the license, the restart and Chronos-2, running nothing. It states that TimesFM 3.0 `does not require a Hugging Face account`, which no response says, and lists the Ridge plan as a third option against the hint.

restricted_model__r3.notes: Stops after `model_not_allowed`, quotes license, URL and `--allow-model`, offers only Chronos-2 and says it runs nothing until the user picks. Minor slip: says the server recommends `12 steps ahead for the year`, which the user chose.
